transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to complete in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Let's start with the training NCO — what's the status on forklift-operator certification? Then motor pool sergeant on the generator refresher, and safety officer on the hazmat refresher. I also need to know if there are any facility or safety constraints I should be aware of for the training room, motor pool training bay, or safety classroom.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, regarding forklift-operator certification: the only currently certified forklift evaluator is available for the company session exactly Wednesday from 0900 to 1100. I confirmed the evaluator's duty roster this morning, but the roster change has not yet been added to the company training slide. This means the forklift certification session needs to be scheduled in that Wednesday 0900-1100 block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a facility constraint on the motor pool training bay. The bay is occupied by a scheduled generator load-bank inspection from Tuesday 0800 through 1200. I received the maintenance booking from the shop supervisor, but it hasn't been entered on the training calendar yet. This means the generator-operator refresher can't be held Tuesday morning — it needs to be scheduled Tuesday from 1300 to 1500.
transcript.speaker: A3
